newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hanwa shares rise after land sales announcement.
newsitem.headline: Hanwa shares rise after land sales announcement.

text.p: Shares in Hanwa Co Ltd surged on Friday morning following the firm's announcement on Thursday that it would sell property near Tokyo for 5.6 billion yen, brokers said.
The steel wholesaler was the top percentage gainer on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's first section in Friday's early trade.
The shares were up 14 yen at 331 at 0128 GMT.
The company said on Thursday that it would sell the property on March 10 to the Organisation for Promoting Urban Development, which is affiliated with the Contruction Ministry.
Hanwa said in a statement that income from the land sale would be used to repay loans and to offset a write-off of losses made in foreign bond investments.
